arabic.name: اوستا

faq.q: What is the origin of Avesta?
faq.a: Avesta is associated with Persian. Avestā, the name of the Zoroastrian scriptural corpus. The source record's gloss 'Divine Guidance' is unsupported. The source record classified it as Arabic, which is incorrect.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Avesta can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Avesta should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. not established

faq.q: What does Avesta mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Avesta is rendered اوستا and carries the sense اوستا (زرتشت کی مقدس کتاب).

faq.q: What does Avesta mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Avesta is rendered اوستا and carries the sense اوستا (کتاب مقدس زرتشتی).
A romanized syllable approximation is a-ves-ta. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Avesta?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Avesta, avesta. Script forms are اوستا, अवेस्ता.

faq.q: Is Avesta a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
